notes.title: The Original Island Launched on September 30th
notes.content:
Dear fans of Lanmeng Technology~ Good morning, The Original Island, the first island survival game developed by Lanmeng Technology, is now available on Steam. Thank you for your support. The original island, which integrates survival, exploration and mystery, will welcome the arrival of all survivors. Go to the store to download and experience it. Solve mysteries, open doors to new worlds, find the secrets hidden in the island, and discover the real reason why you came to this island!
  In the game, if you encounter any problems or have any suggestions for the game, you can join the player discussion group for feedback.

	Discord : https://discord.gg/C8VPTyvfp2
